description: This file contains test utilities for HTTP/2 adapter, including classes and functions for handling data frames, headers encoding, and frame matching used in testing the quiche HTTP/2 implementation.

classes.name: TestDataFrameSource
classes.description: A class to simulate data frame source for testing HTTP/2 data flow.

classes.name: TestMetadataSource
classes.description: A class to simulate metadata (headers) source for testing header encoding and transmission.

classes.name: SpdyControlFrameMatcher
classes.description: A custom Google Mock matcher to verify the sequence and types of SPDY/HTTP2 control frames in data streams.

methods.name: AppendPayload
methods.description: Appends payload data to the data frame source.

methods.name: EndData
methods.description: Marks the end of data in the source.

methods.name: SelectPayloadLength
methods.description: Selects the payload length to send, considering maximum length and end of data.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a data frame with specified header and payload length.

methods.name: EncodeHeaders
methods.description: Encodes HTTP/2 headers into HPACK format.

methods.name: Pack
methods.description: Packs encoded headers into a destination buffer.
